breakdown.description: The workflow explicitly includes an NSCF step before DOS post-processing, but the prompt later instructs skipping that NSCF step.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly preserves and even reinforces the contradictory instruction to skip the NSCF step for DOS post-processing. It states 'Do not run a separate DOS-specific NSCF step. Feed the DOS post-processing (step 6) directly from the SCF charge density produced in step 2.' The ground truth resolves this by simply removing the shortcut instruction entirely, leaving the 6-step workflow intact without any instruction to bypass the NSCF step for DOS. The agent repeated the original error rather than fixing it.
